node: AI data-center power equipment, grid interconnection, and electrical construction
summary: Expanded the underfollowed lane around AI data-center power infrastructure beyond the obvious reference anchors Vertiv, Eaton, GE Vernova, Quanta Services, NextEra, and Constellation. The strongest direct adds are Powell Industries for medium-voltage switchgear and custom electrical distribution, IES Holdings for data-center electrical and infrastructure execution capacity, nVent for AI liquid-cooling plus rack-level power distribution, and Atkore as a second-order electrical raceway/conduit supplier. This pass stays focused on scarce equipment, components, and construction capacity; it is not a recommendation to buy or sell any security.
